data.query:
customEvents
| where name in ('transfer_page_viewed', 'download_started', 'download_completed')
| summarize count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), name
data.title: Link funnel events over time (24h)

data.query:
customEvents
| where name in ('transfer_page_viewed', 'download_started')
| summarize views = count_if(name == 'transfer_page_viewed'), downloads = count_if(name == 'download_started')
| extend conversion = 100.0 * downloads / max(views, 1)
| project conversion
data.title: View-to-download conversion % (24h)

data.query:
customMetrics
| where name == 'link_to_download_seconds'
| summarize avg(value) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
data.title: Link to download seconds (M0: not emitted yet — renders empty until T-25 emits it)
